messages:
maria: Starting a STAGGERED Terraform apply for the IPsec migration. Goal: split TF state by region to reduce blast radius. Window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Plan uploaded: https://ci.internal/redwood/plans/1918501234
ben: Ack. Which regions first?
alice: Start with us-east-1 -> eu-west-1 -> ap-southeast-1, small batches.
maria: Correct. us-east done in dry-run canary earlier. Current plan for prod workspace: https://ci.internal/redwood/plans/1918501234/prod
deploy-bot: terraform plan completed for workspace prod-ipsec-split. Summary: +7 resources, ~3 changes, 0 destroys. Plan URL: https://ci.internal/redwood/plans/1918501234/prod (expires in 2h)
ben: Important: state migration step uses `terraform state mv` to move vpn attachments into new regional state files. Ensure S3 snapshot exists before moving.
maria: Snapshot created: s3://redwood-tfstate-backups/prod-ipsec/1918490000.tfstate
ben: Thanks. I will take the lock when we start.
deploy-bot: Acquired lock on backend: s3://redwood-tfstate/prod-ipsec.tfstate by ben (session 0x9f2)
alice: Applying to eu-west-1 canary subset (3 tunnels) now. Watching BGP and route propagation.
deploy-bot: terraform apply started (target: module.ipsec-eu). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/logs/1918501234/apply
alice: I see BGP flap on tunnel-3, routes not propagating into our transit gateways.
oncall-sre: Seeing spike in internal API 500s for auth-service from eu-west-1. Correlating with route changes.
maria: Hold the rollout. Abort remaining region applies. Do NOT touch ap-southeast-1.
ben: Abort acknowledged. Stopping apply in progress.
deploy-bot: terraform apply aborted by ben. Partial changes recorded in state.
jason: We should restore to pre-migration state snapshot. I have the backup: s3://redwood-tfstate-backups/prod-ipsec/1918490000.tfstate
maria: Agreed. Follow rollback steps from runbook. Minimal commands:```bash
# lock state
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-tfstate-backups/prod-ipsec/1918490000.tfstate /tmp/backup.tfstate
# replace current state
aws s3 cp /tmp/backup.tfstate s3://redwood-tfstate/prod-ipsec.tfstate
# force-unlock if needed
terraform force-unlock -force 0x9f2
```
ben: I'll run the restore now and then re-validate routes. Posting progress.
deploy-bot: Starting state restore job. Uploading backup to s3 and forcing unlock. JobID: restore-1918501234
infra-runbook-bot: Rollback checklist triggered: 1) restore tfstate snapshot 2) validate VPN tunnels healthy 3) confirm BGP sessions established 4) smoke tests green 5) reopen change window for retry
oncall-sre: Confirmed auth-service errors decreasing as routes revert.
ben: Restore complete. Re-ran `terraform refresh` and validated resources match backup.
alice: Verified BGP sessions stable and route tables in eu-west-1 back to expected. Internal traffic looks normal.
maria: Good. We will pause the rest of the migration and add extra preflight checks for route convergence and BGP hold timers. Create follow-up RFC and schedule a narrower window with SRE oncall.
jason: Filed infra ticket INFRA-4123 with logs and state snapshot reference.
maria: Thanks all. We'll post release notes and a short postmortem tomorrow. Closing this thread. :white_check_mark:
